scope: isolated local D1; synthetic credentials; no remote or real-user changes

checks.name: account keys normalize the same identifiers across clients and IPs without a user lookup
known, nonexistent, banned-wrong-password and invalid-verifier failures have the same public credential response
distributed Web and Android guesses share one account budget
nonexistent accounts receive the same account-limit response
one blocked IP pair cannot keep charging or extending the shared account budget
parallel distributed reservations cannot exceed the account budget
rate exhaustion never bans the user or revokes an existing legal session, and expires without extending on denial
successful old-password login clears the completed attempt without applying new-password composition rules
missing limiter storage fails closed instead of issuing credentials
